fact_tables.name: daily_sales_summary
fact_tables.query:
INSERT INTO dw.fact_daily_sales (date_id, product_id, total_revenue, units_sold)
SELECT ds.date_id, ds.product_id, SUM(ds.revenue), SUM(ds.quantity)
FROM staging.sales_raw ds
WHERE ds.sale_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
GROUP BY ds.date_id, ds.product_id
ON CONFLICT (date_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET
  total_revenue = EXCLUDED.total_revenue,
  units_sold = EXCLUDED.units_sold;
